result.detail: No run IDs exist in my citation list, so tool_runs is empty. The file uses Verilog-2001 only (no SystemVerilog string type) and should build on Icarus and on Verilator --binary. It prints the nonce byte by byte and skips null bytes. Expected check count on a clean run is 4 per edge after the first reset (2 pre-edge, 2 post-edge), plus 8 corner checks. A watchdog at 5 ms reports a failure if the stimulus hangs. Only one path prints the verdict, guarded by a flag. Remaining needs: the platform's simulator.run over tb/tb_mac8.v with the approved mac8.v, then an independent review_record. If the nonce plusarg name differs from those tried, the run will fail on the verdict line, not on the design. The fix is a one-line change once the name is known; a question to verification.dynamic.testbench.tech_lead would settle it.
